notes.title: 1.7 Fixes And Effects
notes.notes:
-Increased cloud/object view distance
-Katana will no longer fly out of your hand on collision with boxes/objects
-Katana will stay stuck to your hand on grab
-Throwables now have trails
-Arrows now have trails
-Corrected duplicate collider in arrow causing it to bounce when placed
-Lowered brightness and added colored tint to the controls sign at player start

notes.title: 1.5 Major Fixes Patch+Content Patch
notes.notes:
1.5

Arm swing locomotion now only moves in direction of controllers. You can now look around freely while moving, arms should be swung lower like a power walk

Movement speed raised. Max speed player can reach by faster arm swing also increased

Removed play area border (Don't look down!)

Tennis Racket has realistic colliders now

Tennis Racket can now be grabbed at any point! No more funky snapping!

Basketball Weight Reduced, throw multiplier increased

Tennis Ball has more bounce, pretty easy to send one across the island using a racket!

Beach Ball no longer bounces forever
Revamped Bowling!

Barrels have accurate grab now

Bouncy carp spawner position fixed

Bow power increased

Bow max distance increases with pull

Trees now have proper collision (can grab from inside)

Rocks can be grabbed at any position, no longer just the surface

Added new climb area in cave (on top of the waterfall)

Coconuts are heavier, no longer bouncy
